title.narrative: Sustainable food and nutrition security and transforming smallholders' livelihood in Madhya Pradesh, India

description.narrative: The project's purpose is to reduce malnutrition of vulnerable rural groups in Madhya Pradesh, India, particularly amongst rural youth.At least 50,000 people from rural households, including a significant amount of women and school going children, will be provided with improved access to healthy and diverse food and food intake.Moreover, the project will improve the net income of 30,000 farmers (both male and female) by promoting crop diversification, improved access to inputs and more profitable markets.
